coverage.row: Acceptance 1: Omitted deployment.previewPrefix keeps today's /preview/<port>/ parse, registry URLs, and SW match.
Acceptance 2: deployment.previewPrefix: '/sandbox/preview' is valid Workbench admission when SW scope contains it (scope /sandbox/ or /).
Acceptance 3: Invalid prefix spelling ('', 'preview', '/sandbox/preview/', '//x', '/a/../b', '/a//b', '\\x') throws TypeError / deployment.previewPrefix before SW register.
Acceptance 4: Prefix outside SW scope (scope: '/sandbox/', previewPrefix: '/preview') throws TypeError / deployment.previewPrefix before SW register.

Acceptance 5: With prefix /sandbox/preview, parsePreviewPath / matchPreviewUrl / preview-registry emit and match /sandbox/preview/<port>/ (and rest paths); /preview/<port>/ and /api/preview/<port>/ are not that prefix.

Acceptance 6: Real Chromium: page under /sandbox/, SW scope /sandbox/, prefix /sandbox/preview — iframe navigation, a preview asset, a root-relative guest request, and HMR use the prefixed URL; an unrelated origin path outside the scope is not a preview route.
Fault matrix: corrupt-input × invalid prefix — TypeError naming deployment.previewPrefix before SW register.
Fault matrix: corrupt-input × prefix outside SW scope — same loud throw before register; register not called.
Fault matrix: sibling-drift × prefix — io parse, SW match, and registry URL share one prefix.
Public API: optional deployment.previewPrefix (omitted = /preview); invalid or out-of-scope values throw TypeError naming deployment.previewPrefix.
Public API: parsePreviewPath(path, prefix?) and previewDocumentPath(prefix, port) are the only builders/parsers; PREVIEW_PREFIX_RE remains the default prefix regex.
Public API: SW_ROUTING_VERSION 6→7 for the host-selected prefix addressing shape.

findings.evidence: RIFTY_PLAYGROUND_PORT=5415 pnpm exec playwright test --config playwright.browser-unit.config.ts tests/browser-unit/workbench-preview-prefix.spec.ts — 1 passed (5.2s). Acc 6 HMR conjunct is iframeBody.includes('data-rifty-ws-bridge') (spec.ts:193). packages/net/src/ws/browser-client-script.ts:67 uses /(?:^|\/)preview\/(\d+)(?:\/|$)/ — node probe: /sandbox/preview/9043/ extracts port 9043 (ADR-0189 remap works). guestFrameUrl still strips only a leading /preview/<port>/; probe /sandbox/preview/9043/ws → stripped:false. browser-client-script.test.ts has no /sandbox/preview/ case. A revert to ^/preview/ would still green Acc 6.
findings.summary: Acc 6's HMR probe is the HTML injection marker, not a prefixed WebSocket remap. Port extract now matches /sandbox/preview/<port>/; document-relative WS strip still requires a leading /preview/<port>/; Acc 6 would not catch a ^/preview/ revert.
